name: Valgre Cacoo
title: Totblank
author: Dear folks of R.J.R. -
content: I smoke Camel Special Lights and truly love the flavor above any other cigarette I have tried.
However, they are available at limited locations here in rural Maine. I usually smoke the "crush-proof" box, which was not available the last time I purchased a carton.
So, I purchased a carton of the soft packs and found them very dissatisfactory. They were dry and I had trouble keeping them lit.
I have asked that the retailer I buy them from keep the boxes available. Is there anything I can do to make them more available here?
Thank you for your attention in this matter.
